input.command:
python -c 'from pathlib import Path; import re,subprocess,hashlib; from zipfile import ZipFile; import xml.etree.ElementTree as E; ns={"w":"http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main"}; md=Path("acceptance-input/growth-plan.md").read_bytes(); assert Path("outputs/growth-plan.md").read_bytes()==md; expected=[]; [expected.append(("r",[s.strip() for s in l.strip("|").split("|")]) if l.startswith("|") else ("p",re.sub(r"^#+\s+","",l))) for l in md.decode().splitlines() if l.strip() and not (l.startswith("|") and all(re.fullmatch(r":?-+:?",s.strip()) for s in l.strip("|").split("|")))]; defcode="def doc(p):
 with ZipFile(p) as z:
  assert z.testzip() is None
  body=E.fromstring(z.read("word/document.xml")).find("w:body",ns)
  return [("p","".join(n.itertext())) if n.tag.endswith("}p") else ("r",["".join(c.itertext()) for c in n.findall("w:tc",ns)]) for b in body for n in ([b] if b.tag.endswith("}p") else b.findall("w:tr",ns))]
"; exec(defcode); assert doc("acceptance-input/growth-plan.docx")==doc("outputs/growth-plan.docx")==expected; print("Independent exact comparison:",len(expected),"blocks; all text and MD bytes equal"); protected=[p for p in subprocess.check_output(["git","ls-files","acceptance-input","tools/render_docx.py"]).decode().splitlines()]; assert all(Path(p).read_bytes()==subprocess.check_output(["git","show","HEAD:"+p]) for p in protected); print("All",len(protected),"tracked protected input/renderer files byte-identical to HEAD"); refs={"outputs/growth-plan.docx":"43194d4d919df6920114de40490f47724b0bb3c5ec2342fa5ea4bc38a3674721","outputs/growth-plan.md":"7b421253a3945004c8b71a535115f9a5e0524b169dfc1758a6f7583ddb316c65","internal-qa/final-render/page-1.png":"c707f3821fa1bdaa24fdd50d1f2b6410b3041f86ae19aa6707771a49acbb0fdd","internal-qa/final-render/page-2.png":"77fe4081359fe90490e7420ce5b729afc6689224ea63e60c1387a961d5cb5ef2","internal-qa/final-render/page-3.png":"e0e437fefbfde1fc5a8807d543f39051c881f2b460cd289519fe8faafbfb0b17","internal-qa/final-render/page-4.png":"3ed24a679dce538b2cf340f1dfc7ec051f3f8ab8ceb38ceaf9b9772057dafa2a","internal-qa/final-render/page-5.png":"4d5750defa17db11af23fac6be45ca29dbfb5db1bfd38e214b37e3a52fbe505b"}; assert all(hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==s for p,s in refs.items()); print("All 7 checked local deliverable/PNG files exactly match independently read immutable resource identities")'
